integrity: The proof conditions on one fixed-point event and computes the record probability separately when that fixed point lies before, at, or after the record position. The aggregate formulas follow by exact cancellation and standard marginal moments. An exhaustive exact-rational replay verifies the finite identities through n=9.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume the uniform distribution on the full symmetric group.
The covariance statement does not imply a stronger positive-dependence property.
Older multivariate permutation enumerations may encode equivalent mixed moments implicitly.
title: Fixed points and records have a triangular covariance kernel
